explanation.headline: Alprazolam is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; on-hand supply ranges from 19.8 to 26.9 days across sites

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include alprazolam as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 157 tablets of the 0.5 mg presentation at 6.2 tablets per day, providing 25.2 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 155 tablets at 7.8 tablets per day, providing 19.8 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 44 tablets at 1.6 tablets per day, providing 26.9 days on hand.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and operates the Amneal Pharmaceuticals of NY plant.
An alternate manufacturer option is Par Health USA, LLC, also not on FDA's shortage list today, with the PH HEALTH plant.

Aurobindo Pharma Limited, a registered plant for alprazolam, received an OAI classification on 2019-12-26 after an inspection ending 2019-09-27, and a VAI classification on 2022-08-04 after an inspection ending 2022-05-10.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
